  "anomaly_detected": true,
  "confidence": 0.7,
  "anomalies": [
    {
      "category": "wrong_value",
      "components": ["C46"],
      "pins": ["C46.1", "C46.2"],
      "nets": ["VC1", "Net-(C46-Pad2)"],
      "observed": "C46 is valued \"22pF 100v\" in the netlist and the SPICE deck (C46 ... 22pF), but its LCSC part C313105 and MPN CC0603KRX7R0BB223 are the 22nF X7R part, and its description reads \"100V 22nF X7R\". The sister cells C42, C44 and C45 in the same VC1..VC4 filter chain are all 22nF.",
      "expected": "C46 should be 22nF (22n), matching its part number, description and the other three filter capacitors (C42, C44, C45) on the same R41/R42/R43/R44 network.",
      "evidence": [
        {"source": "netlist", "quote": "(comp (ref \"C46\") (value \"22pF 100v\")"},
        {"source": "netlist", "quote": "(field (name \"MPN\") \"CC0603KRX7R0BB223\")"},
        {"source": "netlist", "quote": "(comp (ref \"C45\") (value \"22nF 100v\")"},
        {"source": "spice", "quote": "C46 VC1 Net-_C46-Pad2_ 22pF"}
      ],
      "impact": "With 75 Ω in series, a 22 pF capacitor gives a time constant around 1.7 ns instead of about 1.7 µs. The VC1 cell-voltage filter then no longer filters or matches the other three channels, so the voltage-sense readings for cell 1 will be inconsistent.",
      "confidence": 0.7
    },
    {
      "category": "open_connection",
      "components": ["D30", "R60", "R59"],
      "pins": ["D30.2", "D30.4", "R60.1", "R60.2", "R59.2"],
      "nets": ["Net-(D30-K2)", "ESTOP_OUT", "Net-(D30-K1)"],
      "observed": "D30 channel 2 has anode A2 (pin 4) on ESTOP_OUT and cathode K2 (pin 2) through R60 to ESTOP_OUT (R60 pin 2 is on ESTOP_OUT). Both ends of the LED-plus-resistor series string sit on the same node, so the channel carries no current. The mirror channel 1 uses R59 with its pin 2 on GND.",
      "expected": "The e-stop indicator LED channel should return its current through R60 to GND, mirroring R59 on channel 1.",
      "evidence": [
        {"source": "netlist", "quote": "(net (code \"67\") (name \"ESTOP_OUT\") ... (node (ref \"D30\") (pin \"4\") (pinfunction \"A2\") ...) (node (ref \"R60\") (pin \"2\") ...)"},
        {"source": "netlist", "quote": "(net (code \"129\") (name \"Net-(D30-K2)\") ... (node (ref \"R60\") (pin \"1\") ...)"},
        {"source": "spice", "quote": "R60 Net-_D30-K2_ ESTOP_OUT 130"},
        {"source": "spice", "quote": "R59 Net-_D30-K1_ 0 130"}
      ],
      "impact": "The e-stop status LED on channel 2 can never light, so the indicator does not show the state of the ESTOP_OUT line. Channel 1 is wired correctly, which points to a single wrong connection.",
      "confidence": 0.4
    },
    {
      "category": "wrong_value",
      "components": ["R36"],
      "pins": ["R36.1", "R36.2"],
      "nets": ["VOUTN", "VOUTP"],
      "observed": "R36 is valued \"24k\" in the netlist and SPICE deck, but its description reads \"24Ω\" and its MPN FRC0805J240TSD encodes 24 Ω.",
      "expected": "The value field should match the 24 Ω part that was actually sourced, or the BOM part should be changed to a 24 kΩ part.",
      "evidence": [
        {"source": "netlist", "quote": "(comp (ref \"R36\") (value \"24k\")"},
        {"source": "netlist", "quote": "(field (name \"MPN\") \"FRC0805J240TSD\")"},
        {"source": "spice", "quote": "R36 VOUTN VOUTP 24k"}
      ],
      "impact": "If the 24 Ω part is fitted, it loads the VOUTP/VOUTN output very heavily. If the 24 kΩ value is intended, the BOM would order the wrong part.",
      "confidence": 0.3
    }
  ],
  "summary": "The most likely anomaly is C46 valued 22pF where its part number and the other three cells in the same filter chain are 22nF, a factor-of-1000 error. I also flagged a likely miswired e-stop indicator LED (R60 returned to ESTOP_OUT instead of GND) and a 24k/24Ω value mismatch on R36, both at lower confidence."
}

anomalies.observed: C46 is valued "22pF 100v" in the netlist and the SPICE deck (C46 ... 22pF), but its LCSC part C313105 and MPN CC0603KRX7R0BB223 are the 22nF X7R part, and its description reads "100V 22nF X7R". The sister cells C42, C44 and C45 in the same VC1..VC4 filter chain are all 22nF.
anomalies.expected: C46 should be 22nF (22n), matching its part number, description and the other three filter capacitors (C42, C44, C45) on the same R41/R42/R43/R44 network.
anomalies.impact: With 75 Ω in series, a 22 pF capacitor gives a time constant around 1.7 ns instead of about 1.7 µs. The VC1 cell-voltage filter then no longer filters or matches the other three channels, so the voltage-sense readings for cell 1 will be inconsistent.

anomalies.observed: D30 channel 2 has anode A2 (pin 4) on ESTOP_OUT and cathode K2 (pin 2) through R60 to ESTOP_OUT (R60 pin 2 is on ESTOP_OUT). Both ends of the LED-plus-resistor series string sit on the same node, so the channel carries no current. The mirror channel 1 uses R59 with its pin 2 on GND.
anomalies.expected: The e-stop indicator LED channel should return its current through R60 to GND, mirroring R59 on channel 1.
anomalies.impact: The e-stop status LED on channel 2 can never light, so the indicator does not show the state of the ESTOP_OUT line. Channel 1 is wired correctly, which points to a single wrong connection.

anomalies.observed: R36 is valued "24k" in the netlist and SPICE deck, but its description reads "24Ω" and its MPN FRC0805J240TSD encodes 24 Ω.
anomalies.expected: The value field should match the 24 Ω part that was actually sourced, or the BOM part should be changed to a 24 kΩ part.
anomalies.impact: If the 24 Ω part is fitted, it loads the VOUTP/VOUTN output very heavily. If the 24 kΩ value is intended, the BOM would order the wrong part.
